summary.text: Bobby Singleton, a Democrat, has represented District 24 in the Alabama State Senate since 2005 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: He was elected Alabama State Senate Minority Leader on December 22, 2018.
Singleton received a B.S. from Alabama State University and a J.D. from Miles Law School, and his professional experience includes working in consulting.
